source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 4 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. | CRON 20261002: EPS filled from Ecobank Transnational Incorporated five-year summary page 50 (columns 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021), printed "Earnings per share-basic(cents)" as 1.680, 1.371, 1.170, 1.165, 1.063. The FY2025 and FY2024 cells already stored agree with that same line, so the remaining three years are taken from the same source and the same unit (US cents). | CRON 20261002: income rows rewritten in US dollar units from the issuer own audited consolidated statements, page 50 five-year summary and page 14 statement of comprehensive income. The rows previously stored matched no audited line (FY2025 Profit Before Tax read 384,260 against the audited 800,905 thousand), so every margin rendered was wrong. Cost of Sales and Gross Profit do not exist for a bank and are not written.

source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47568_ECOBANK_TRANSNATIONAL_INCORPORATED-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. currency_note: Ecobank reports in United States dollars. Profit before tax less taxation equals 600,281 profit after tax from continuing operations; the audited statement then deducts a 6,159 loss from discontinued operations to reach the 594,122 profit after tax stored as Net Profit.
